Name: Cornucopia Trees Retextured (Converted from PPJA)
Author: cocacola1018
Description:
When PPJA became deprecated, I was thrilled to discover Cornucopia, but deeply missed NinTheCactus69's retexture mod for the trees. So, after obtaining permission, I converted it to the new format!

Because some trees present in PPJA are not in Cornucopia, and vice versa, I chose to reassign some of the art to a different tree species than it was for the original. (I tried to reassign such that the new options' art would match the real-life equivalents throughout the seasons, but it's not perfect so sorry to any botany fans out there! I would've made some tree art myself but pixel art is tricky.) Also, the current hand-drawn sprites already present in Cornucopia--avocado, pear, lemon, lime--are not replaced, because PPJA has fewer trees than Cornucopia. Since I wasn't adding any of my own art to compensate for the increased tree quantity, it made the most sense to leave the already-customized ones as-is.

All credit goes to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/NinTheCactus69/about-me]NinTheCactus69[/url] for their stunning art, and the Cornucopia team ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2821799]MizuJakkaru[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/55537262]6480[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/158706123]DraconisLeonidas[/url]) for making the wonderful Cornucopia mod!!

Side note, the recolor mods visible in the screenshots are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15079]Better Water[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23095?tab=description]Soft Slow Seasons[/url] :)
